title: Steam will sometimes just exclude a dll file when installing the game?

posts.author: knuckles_the_chuckles
posts.body:
So I'm working on a game called Night of the Abattoir Man, available on steam for free.
I made this game using rpg maker vx ace.
Recently I sent the game link to a reviewer so her could play a game.
To my absolute horror, a couple of days later I recieve an email from him saying that he wasn't able to open the game cuz he got the following error:
This is the error message that pops up when a dll file is missing, in this case "F1AltEnterF12.dll"
This is odd because that file should most definitely be there?
Also, the reviewer said he tried validating files and re-installing the game but that didn't fix the issue.
The weirdest part is that I've only seen this error pop up one other time before.
When my producer first installed the game, the main rpg maker dll file was missing for some reason.
Then after that I've never seen this happen again until this reviewer sent me that screenshot.
I even uninstalled the game, deleted the steam folder, reinstalled the game just to see if the error would pop up for me but no, the dll file is there.
My guess is that steam just sometimes doesn't install the dll files? But why?
Is this a steam problem? Is there a way to prevent this from happening?
I really don't want this to happen again in the future.

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body:
Did you install that file on Windows? Or did you copy it to the Windows System folder manually? If you did that, it'd obviously work on your PC but not on other people's.
I mentioned that because it always matters whenever you are distributing an app. People might forget those little details at some point, and then they get surprised by the missing DLLs messages popping up.
Anyway, in your case I'd have to install it to get an idea of why it's not being installed.

Kursor Ace
# * Kursor ACE * #
#   Scripter : Kyonides Arkanthes
#   v1.0.2 - 2023-12-12
# * Distributed AS IS * #
# This script allows you to use a custom weapon icon as a cursor on any default
# menu script plus the save file windows.
# It uses the CursorSet which is nothing but a modified version of the RTP's
# IconSet file found at the Graphics/System directory.
# * Optional Script Call * #
#   Let us say you created a cursor and named it @cursor and you do not want to
#   use the default menu icon. You would need to call this method:
# @cursor.icon_index = Number
#   Example:
# @cursor.icon_index = 40
module Kursor
CURSOR_INDEX = 0
CURSOR_OFFSET_X = -8
CURSOR_OFFSET_Y = 9
STATUS_CURSOR_OFFSET_X = 112
STATUS_CURSOR_OFFSET_Y = 48
SAVE_CURSOR_OFFSET_X = 8
SAVE_CURSOR_OFFSET_Y = 16
SAVE_CURSOR_RECT_BLINK = false
CURSOR_HEIGHT = 24
CURSOR_FILENAME = "CursorSet"
module Methods
def setup_cursor
@cursor = Kursor::Cursor.new(self)
end
def x=(nx)
@cursor.x = nx if @cursor
super(nx)
end
def y=(ny)
@cursor.y = ny if @cursor
super(ny)
end
def visible=(state)
@cursor.visible = (state and open? and
@Index
>= 0) if @cursor
super(state)
end
def viewport=(vp)
@cursor.viewport = vp
super vp
end
def close
@cursor.visible = false
super
end
def show
@cursor.visible = true
super
end
def hide
@cursor.visible = false
super
end
def update_open
super
@cursor.visible = (open? and
@Index
>= 0)
end
end
class Cursor < Sprite
def initialize(parent)
super(parent.viewport)
@parent = parent
@offset_mode = parent.cursor_offset
@icon_index = $game_system.cursor_index
setup_offset
setup_base_xy(parent.x, parent.y)
self.z = parent.z + 200
self.bitmap = Bitmap.new(CURSOR_HEIGHT, CURSOR_HEIGHT)
create_contents
end
def setup_offset
case @offset_mode
when :default
@offset_x = CURSOR_OFFSET_X
@offset_y = CURSOR_OFFSET_Y
when :save
@offset_x = SAVE_CURSOR_OFFSET_X
@offset_y = SAVE_CURSOR_OFFSET_Y
when :status
@offset_x = STATUS_CURSOR_OFFSET_X
@offset_y = STATUS_CURSOR_OFFSET_Y
end
end
def setup_base_xy(bx=0, by=0)
@base_x = @offset_x + bx
@base_y = @offset_y + by
self.x = @base_x
self.y = @base_y
end
def create_empty
Bitmap.new(384, CURSOR_HEIGHT * 3)
end
def create_contents
bit = Cache.system(CURSOR_FILENAME) rescue create_empty
cw = bit.width / CURSOR_HEIGHT
cx = @icon_index % cw * CURSOR_HEIGHT
cy = @icon_index / cw * CURSOR_HEIGHT
rect = Rect.new(cx, cy, CURSOR_HEIGHT, CURSOR_HEIGHT)
self.bitmap.blt(0, 0, bit, rect)
end
def recreate_contents
self.bitmap.clear
create_contents
end
def x=(nx)
@base_x = @offset_x + nx
super @base_x
end
def y=(ny)
@base_y = @offset_y + ny
super @base_y
end
def dispose_all
bitmap.dispose
dispose
end
attr_accessor :icon_index
end
end
class Game_System
alias :kyon_kursor_gm_sys_init :initialize
def initialize
kyon_kursor_gm_sys_init

attr_accessor :cursor_index, :cursor_save_blink

include Kursor::Methods
alias :kyon_kursor_win_sel_init :initialize
alias :kyon_kursor_win_sel_disp :dispose

def initialize(wx, wy, w, h)
kyon_kursor_win_sel_init(wx, wy, w, h)

check_cursor_visibility
end
def check_cursor_visibility(n=@index)

end
def index=(n)
check_cursor_visibility(n)
kyon_kursor_win_sel_set_index(n)
end
def update_cursor
if @cursor_all
self.top_row = 0
@cursor.y = self.y - self.oy + rect.y
elsif
@Index
>= 0
ensure_cursor_visible
rect = item_rect(
@Index
)
@cursor.x = self.x - self.ox + rect.x
@cursor.y = self.y - self.oy + rect.y
end
end
def dispose
@cursor.dispose_all
kyon_kursor_win_sel_disp
end
def cursor_offset
:default
end
attr_reader :cursor_index
end

:status

end
class Window_ChoiceList
alias :kyon_kursor_win_chc_lst_init :initialize
def initialize(message_window)
kyon_kursor_win_chc_lst_init(message_window)

end

@cursor.visible = (self.visible and open? and n >= 0)
end
end
class Window_SaveFile
include Kursor::Methods
alias :kyon_kursor_win_sv_file_init :initialize
alias :kyon_kursor_win_sv_file_disp :dispose
alias :kyon_kursor_win_sv_file_up_cursor :update_cursor
def initialize(height, index)
kyon_kursor_win_sv_file_init(height, index)
setup_cursor
check_cursor_visibility
end
def check_cursor_visibility
@cursor.visible = @selected
end
def update_cursor
check_cursor_visibility
kyon_kursor_win_sv_file_up_cursor if $game_system.cursor_save_blink
end
def dispose
@cursor.dispose_all
kyon_kursor_win_sv_file_disp
end
def cursor_offset
:save
end
end
